metadata.title: A monodromy relation for the Cartwright-Steger fibration
metadata.abstract: We study the genus-$19$ Albanese fibration of the Cartwright--Steger surface and its order-three symmetry. Passing to the orbifold quotient of the elliptic base gives a relation among the two handle monodromies and the three Dehn twists about the vanishing cycles. The two real vanishing paths give cycles whose real fixed points lie on different ovals of the invariant fiber. For a cyclic triple cover, we express the intersection of a curve with its image under the deck transformation as a signed crossing count on the quotient. We determine the two local branch values of a degree-$72$ bicanonical pencil near a node and study a symmetric bicanonical pencil. A general pencil also gives a finite degree-$72$ map from a blowup of the surface to the product of the elliptic curve and a projective line. The monodromy translates of the nodal vanishing classes span the first homology of a smooth fiber.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Cartwright–Steger 纤维化的 monodromy 关系
analysis.workSummary: 研究亏格 19 Albanese 纤维化与三阶对称，给出椭圆基 orbifold 商上的把柄 monodromy 和消失圈 Dehn twists 关系，分析循环覆盖交数及 72 次双典范 pencil。
analysis.breakthrough: 把高亏格纤维化的对称、局部节点和同调生成联系。
analysis.limitations: 对称 pencil 与一般 pencil 的结论不同；消失路径的实固定点位置须按指定选择。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 LLM 用于语法编辑和辅助部分计算。
